outcome: Association between PMMH and obstetric and psychosocial factors
cohort: 702 pregnant women who attended prenatal care at 12 or more weeks of gestation
finding: Nine out of ten pregnant women had flourishing PMMH, and none had languishing PMMH; general loneliness, social loneliness, and anxiety were associated with non-flourishing PMMH, while obstetric factors were not.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was not associated with non-flourishing positive maternal mental health in this study.
